snippet.title: Randventure – Gameplay Trailer | a 1-bit roguelite played in a single swipe
snippet.description:
Randventure is Slay the Spire × Reigns: a 1-bit, turn-based roguelite played in a single swipe. Slide your heroes left or right to cast a spell, pick an event or choose an evolution. Build your team of three heroes, journey through three acts and evolve them along the way.

Wishlist it on Steam · Free demo coming soon · Press kit: randventure.epreyn.com

7 heroes · 28 evolved forms · 210 runes · 6 biomes · online multiplayer for two · 9 languages

Music: AlkaKrab · Developed by Epreyn (Perpignan, France)
